text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Aaah... So tired...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: It's so hoooot... I have zero motivatiooon...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff A
text_block_list.text: A lot of girls haven't had much energy lately, huh...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Must be summer fatigue.
I really want to do something for her, though...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff A
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's some nice dish out there that can cure summer fatigue in one fell swoop...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Summer fatigue...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I wonder if there's something I can do with my cooking...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (No, with who I am now—!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Keeping nutritional value in mind...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Preserving the natural flavors of the ingredients...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (If I do that, surely............)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: This will surely blow away everyone's summer fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right, I've gotta give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
First, the veggies! Tomatoes, eggplants, and okra!
Seasonal vegetables are super nutritious after all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I can turn this into a dish that captures the season
without ruining the ingredients――

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
What should I do, I can't think of anything~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still—Ikuno-san, Zephyr-san,
and you too, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've only ever received help up until now,
so this time, I have to give it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I can't take this! I'm gonna go for a quick walk!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder what would be good...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!?
Guess who~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san...!
Phew... You startled me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry, sorry.
I just couldn't resist teasing you a bit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you had this super dark aura
coming off your back, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're putting way too much pressure on yourself.
Come on, just relax your shoulders~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
B-But this time for sure...
I want to make everyone happy with my own power!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha, that sounds just like Flower.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Still, haven't you always cooked with the desire to make people happy?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, sure, maybe you got some advice.
But without you, Flower, that happiness wouldn't exist.
Don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it only worked out because someone came to my rescue...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're so serious~ Don't worry, it'll be fine.
Just relax, relax~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Don't put so much pressure on yourself.
You might be surprised—sometimes when you just believe in yourself and push forward, things turn out great."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Believe in myself... you say?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yup! And besides, at the very least, I love Flower's cooking, so I'd be happy no matter what you make~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky-san...
Nishino Flower had made some food to help combat summer fatigue, and I came over to give it a taste test.

In the past, it was egg porridge, autumn vegetable ankake...
Having prepared delicate dishes for others before, the meal she prepared to combat summer fatigue was—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's summer vegetable curry!
I used vegetables that are in season.
Summer veggies are the best way to beat the heat, after all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I just stewed all the vegetables whole, all together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I figured sometimes you need a little boldness!
Ah, but I'm not cutting any corners, promise!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I simmered it thoroughly until the eggplant and tomato skins practically melted away!
It's a curry packed full of nutrients!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I think it turned out really delicious!
Please, everyone, give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff B
text_block_list.text:
"It's so smooth... completely free of stringiness!
Just how long was this simmered for?!"

The acidity of the tomatoes whets the appetite,
while the melt-in-your-mouth eggplant and okra make the curry slide smoothly down one's throat...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! Really?!
Thank goodness~!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... This is delicious.
Please, let us put it on our menu!

Afterward, Nishino Flower's special summer vegetable curry
became a popular menu item in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thanks for the meal!
Alright, time for training!

At the same time, perhaps thanks to Nishino Flower,
the number of students suffering from summer fatigue steadily decreased.
